headlines.title: Turkey’s monopolies watchdog takes on all comers
headlines.snippet: From Meta, Adidas and Coca-Cola to poultry packers and hazelnut traders, the list of companies that have run up against Turkey’s Competition Authority (Rekabet Kurumu, or RK) continues to grow. Established in 1997, in the wake of Turkey’s customs union with the EU, the RK exists to benefit consumers by combatting cartels and monopolies, protecting the market mechanism and lowering barriers to market entry.

headlines.title: GTA VI: Why the 13-year wait could be worth $8 billion
headlines.snippet: After more than 13 years, Grand Theft Auto VI finally launches on November 19, and it's about a lot more than a video game. Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Pras Subramanian follows the money: why Take-Two is telling investors to expect $8 billion-plus in bookings this year but only about $109 million to $142 million in profit, how GTA Online's recurring spending became the real prize, and why Sony and Microsoft can cash in without making the game at all.
